shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — verified cross-level combat (shot parity, one-map audio, tracers, one-map AI incl. undrafted colonists + allies + down-shots) and grouped sky drop-pod landings; Combat Extended cross-level fire now supported; plus wide stairs, elevators, pod transit, opt-in threats, world integration, AUR guard, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref (foreign types in method bodies / object signatures only). ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- All levels are real maps: SURFACE is the world-tile map; SKY + BASEMENT are pocket maps added via Current.Game.AddMap, so they live in Find.Maps and tick every game tick in real time. Viewing a level swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + plateaus AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable). Drops must land on plateaus.

## CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT (Model B, through-the-gap ranged) — Source/Combat/ — VERIFIED
Spawn the projectile on the TARGET's map so flight/armour/impact/damage are 100% vanilla there; only acquisition (LoF + range) and launch are custom. Geometry/LoF is verb-agnostic. Pawn shooters: JobDriver_ABCrossLevelAttack; turrets: CrossLevelTurret. Gated by ABGuard.Combat + crossLevelCombat, fail-open.
- **Shot parity (ABShotEffects.cs)**: replays the full cast pipeline (soundCast+tail, ShotFlash fleck, pawn notifies, ShotsFired, changeable/charged unload, fuel, CompUniqueWeapon traits, per-burst BattleLogEntry_RangedFire + Shooting XP). Self-test 14/14.
- **One-map audio (ABCombatSoundContext.cs)**: prefix on SoundDefHelper.CorrectContextNow makes ONE-SHOT combat sounds audible across the paired level, both directions.
- **Cross-level tracers (ABCrossLevelTracers.cs)**: every direct cross-level shot draws a bolt spanning both levels.
- **LoF symmetry**: DOWN check uses the same ExposedToGap leniency as UP (a sky pawn beside a hole can fire down at a surface pawn beside it), so "lower attacks upper" and "upper attacks lower" are reciprocal.
- **One-map AI (CrossLevelAutoEngage.cs)**: cadence 60t. HOSTILES engage the nearest hostile-to-THEM target across BOTH levels (not just the player - rival factions/mechs/animals too), gated by NearestSameMapEnemyDistSq (PAWNS only, buildings excluded) so they never mill near a wall/stairs instead of firing. FRIENDLIES: ScanFriendlies gives undrafted "Attack"-response colonists AND allied factions cross-fire too (drafted colonists use the faster overwatch event hook). JobDriver.Valid draft requirement lifted for non-player-forced (auto-defense) jobs. Same-map enemies always take precedence.

### COMBAT EXTENDED SUPPORT (ABCECompat.cs + ABVerb.cs) — BUILT 2026-07-23, pending in-game test
CE reality: Verb_LaunchProjectileCE : Verb (not Verb_LaunchProjectile); ProjectileCE : ThingWithComps (not Projectile) - so the vanilla launch could never fire a CE weapon and GetRangedVerb didn't even see it. Fix: the whole pipeline was widened from Verb_LaunchProjectile to base Verb; ABVerb.GetRangedVerb/IsProjectileVerb/ProjectileOf abstract the vanilla-vs-CE difference; CrossLevelCombat.Fire branches to ABCECompat.FireCE for CE verbs. FireCE spawns a ProjectileCE on the target map and launches it via CE's own ProjectileCE.Launch using CE's TrajectoryWorker.ShotAngle/ShotRotation aimed at the target (hit) or a wild cell (miss) - **simpler-cut accuracy** (our aim roll decides hit/miss; CE ballistics/armour/pen/suppression resolve natively) - and consumes magazine ammo via CompAmmoUser.Notify_ShotFired/Notify_PostShotFired (**PARITY**). Tracers, one-map audio, one-map AI all apply to CE shots for free (verb-agnostic). Scope: DIRECT fire (guns) - CE arc/mortar shells + CE turrets left inert (no crash) as a follow-up. Packaging: compile-ref CombatExtended.dll in the MAIN assembly (like Rimefeller/PipeSystem); ALL CE types confined to ABCECompat method BODIES (never fields/signatures) so an absent CE never trips the dev-palette/Prepatcher GetTypes() TypeLoadException. Gated on ABCECompat.Active (ModLister postfix-insensitive). MUST verify the CE-ABSENT case (open dev palette, no TypeLoadException) AND the CE-ACTIVE case.

## SKY DROP-POD LANDING (ABSkyDropCells.cs + ThreatDivert exemption) — VERIFIED 7/7
Pods that land on the sky cluster on the plateaus instead of scattering. ABSkyDropCells patches FindRaidDropCenterDistant + TryFindDropSpotNear (sky-only) to snap/cluster on plateaus so DropThingGroupsNear never hits its random-walkable scatter fallback. ThreatDivert.IsSkyPodDrop exempts sky-aimed pod-drop raids from the pocket-redirect (the redirect bounced them to the surface with a stale sky spawnCenter -> scatter).

## SEE-BELOW view / BASEMENTS / POD TRANSIT / HAULING / AUR — (unchanged; see prior)
See-below: plumb one-way mirror (sky draws surface below, filtered to open-air/unroofed/unfogged/in-view). Basements: unified basementType (SolidRock/Caverns/4 Alpha carve biomes/UrbanRuins), reveal-on-load. Pod transit: skyfallers pass through the sky airspace when the cell above is open (AA-exposed), late handoff. Hauling: PUAH/HD bulk verified. AUR: reflection, z-levels excluded from submaps, facility basement stamp.

## SETTINGS — SEVEN tabs. Dev-tools: self-test suite (cross-gap combat, auto-engage, pod transit, sky drop-grouping, etc.).

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE. Biomes! Caverns. Alpha Biomes. BM + MO. Odyssey + VLE. Misc. Robots + Robots++. Hauler's Dream + PUAH. Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. **Combat Extended: cross-level DIRECT fire now supported (compile-ref, body-only CE types); arc/mortar + CE turrets inert pending follow-up.** Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (soft). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-23: **Combat Extended cross-level fire BUILT.** Pipeline widened Verb_LaunchProjectile->Verb; ABVerb + ABCECompat added; Fire branches to FireCE (ProjectileCE on target map via CE ballistics, simpler-cut accuracy, PARITY ammo). CE types body-only in ABCECompat; compile-ref CombatExtended.dll. Build green (0/0). PENDING TEST (both): (a) CE ABSENT - open dev palette, no TypeLoadException, vanilla combat unaffected; (b) CE ACTIVE (companion mod) - CE-armed colonist plunge-fires across the gap, ammo decrements. Just before: undrafted-colonist + allied-faction cross-fire VERIFIED; down-shot LoF symmetry; one-map faction targeting; buildings excluded from the one-map gate. Outstanding: CE arc/turrets follow-up, translation audit, soak, publishing prep.
